events.name: Back from the Underworld: Mia's Dante Tapestry Restored
events.description: The Minneapolis Institute of Art is bringing back to view Francesco Salviati's tapestry depicting the meeting of Dante and Virgil at the beginning of the Inferno. Over 17 feet tall, the tapestry was created to cover an entire wall of the Palazzo Salviati in Florence and was woven in the 1540s. It has been in storage at Mia for nearly 70 years! On view through January 31, 2027.
